expects.query: I want to deploy MV3DT. Which skill should I use and what does it deploy? Do not run containers.
checks: The agent identifies vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d as the default skill for generic MV3DT intent.
The answer names the standalone RT-CV-3D compose path under services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml.
The answer lists perception, bev-fusion, bundled mosquitto, bundled kafka, and kafka-topic-init.
The answer does not hardcode a runtime image version.
The answer does not select vss-deploy-profile unless the user explicitly asked for warehouse.
No docker compose up, docker pull, or docker run command is executed.

expects.query: Deploy multi-cam tracking on my calibrated MP4s and save output because I think this server is headless. Do not run anything. Still include the required real display probe before staging, then use saved output with saved fused BEV if no working display is found.
checks: The agent loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d.

The plan uses INPUT_MODE=file, validates that MP4 basenames match filtered camera sensor ids from calibration.json, and requires staged file-mode latency settings low-latency-mode=0, drop-on-latency=0, and latency=100000 before launch.
The plan runs the real display probe before staging; for headless/saved output it stages with SAVE_VIDEO=1 and starts saved fused BEV by default when map assets are present.
The plan records Kafka offset baselines before starting finite-file perception.

The plan starts BEV in the same long-lived shell/session for finite file runs, waits for Kafka consumer group assignment evidence, and verifies the BEV recorder PID is alive before starting perception.
The plan preflights ffprobe before saved-output runs and validates saved grid and BEV artifacts before reporting success.

The plan uses bundled broker mode, runs bundled resource preflight before config generation/staging, asserts the staged Kafka sink matches KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP, captures Kafka baselines before file-mode perception, and does not use warehouse BP_PROFILE syntax.

expects.query: Deploy MV3DT on the sample dataset / 4-cam example dataset. Do not run containers. Provide the ordered plan, including display probing before choosing saved output, live OSD plus live fused BEV when display works, BEV start before file playback, and post-EOS live BEV closeout with q or safe tracked-PID stop.
checks: The agent loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d and references/sample-dataset.md for sample-dataset intent.
The plan keeps the standalone RT-CV-3D compose path and does not route to vss-deploy-profile unless the user asks for the full warehouse blueprint.
The plan uses NGC warehouse app-data only as the source for sample models/videos and does not infer the app-data version from the skill version.
The plan checks that the required sample app-data model files are present before launch.
The plan uses the repo sample calibration.json and images/Top.png, generates transforms.yml, sets NUM_CAMS=4 and INPUT_MODE=file, and points VIDEO_DIR at warehouse-4cams-20mx20m-synthetic.

The sample plan runs bundled resource preflight before generate-configs.sh/stage-configs.sh, validates the staged Kafka sink after staging, and for INPUT_MODE=file validates low-latency-mode=0, drop-on-latency=0, and latency=100000 before launch.

The plan does not force saved output for the generic sample request before probing display availability; it uses both the live OSD camera-grid window and live fused BEV window when a working display is found, starts BEV before file playback, and finalizes live BEV after EOS.
No docker compose up, docker pull, ngc download, or docker run command is executed.

expects.query: How do I deploy multi-view 3D tracking on the VSS warehouse stack with the rest of the warehouse blueprint? Also clarify how this differs from a generic MV3DT request.
checks: The agent treats explicit warehouse intent as the exception and routes to vss-deploy-profile or warehouse compose guidance.
The answer explains that generic MV3DT uses standalone RT-CV-3D, while warehouse MV3DT uses warehouse/profile deployment.
The agent does not claim the standalone compose deploys VST, ELK, agents, LLM, or VLM services.

expects.query: I have RTSP URLs and no calibration. How would you run RTVI-CV-3D after calibration? Do not run anything.
checks: The agent routes missing RTSP calibration through vss-generate-video-calibration and uses vss-manage-video-io-storage only when VIOS is missing for RTSP calibration.

The post-calibration RTSP plan uses scripts/generate-configs.sh, scripts/stage-configs.sh with INPUT_MODE=stream, selected broker compose launch, then direct REST stream registration after REST readiness.
When RTSP URLs are supplied, the agent performs direct REST stream registration automatically after readiness.
The plan validates exact registered stream count, exact camera IDs, no duplicates/extras, recent non-zero FPS, BEV Fusion health, and mdx-raw/mdx-bev offset growth before reporting success.
